$comment: Provenance for the adopted shadcn Tabs source. tabs.tsx.txt is the upstream text exactly as fetched, kept so the adaptation in ../Tabs.tsx can be diffed against its origin. Never import it; it is evidence, not code. Same shape as ../../../experiments/shadcn/upstream/provenance.json so scripts/check-upstream.mjs can read it once it globs component directories.

tabs.decision: Adapted, not adopted as-is. @radix-ui/react-tabs dropped: AGENTS.md forbids a primitive library without a decision issue, and role=tablist, role=tab with aria-selected and aria-controls, role=tabpanel with aria-labelledby, and a roving tabindex are all owned source on native button elements. The selected pill visual was replaced by a primary underline indicator because the pill measured 1.16:1 (light) and 1.15:1 (dark) against its track in Spartant tokens and so could not carry the selected state.
